sections.bio:
Talent Acquisition Specialist specialized in full-scope tech/non-tech talent recruitment: job ad description writing, job positioning, direct sourcing, candidate screening, interviewing.
Practiced in developing and establishing recruitment strategies, engaging with social media, identifying/recruiting appropriate talent, and achieving recruitment objectives. 
Frontend and Backend Developers (React, Node.js, C++, .NET, PHP, Java, Python), QA, PMs, system administrators, DevOps Engineers, Designers, Leads, etc.
- Proficient in utilizing Boolean Search, X-ray (etc.) for effective candidate sourcing.
- Experienced in conducting cold outreach for talent acquisition.
- Skilled in using ATS (Applicant Tracking System) software for streamlined recruitment processes.
- Strong time management abilities to ensure efficient workflow.
- High level of negotiation skills for successful candidate placement.
- Attentive to details, ensuring accuracy in candidate evaluation.
- A people person with excellent interpersonal skills.
- Experienced in conducting one-on-one meetings.
- Team leading experience.

Please feel free to contact me about current positions in direct messages or: [email protected]

Most LinkedIn outreach fails for one simple reason:
You’re talking to people who don’t want to buy.
And no amount of “personalized messaging” fixes that.
That’s the real problem with traditional sales tools - they optimize messaging, not intent.
I recently came across Gojiberry AI, and the idea behind it is very different.
Instead of sending messages to cold prospects, it focuses only on high-intent leads - people who are already showing signals that they’re actively looking for a solution.
So instead of guessing who might be interested, sales teams can focus directly on prospects who are already in buying mode.
What this changes in practice:
→ less time wasted on cold outreach
→ higher reply rates because timing is better
→ more meaningful conversations instead of spammy sequences
→ a much cleaner, more focused pipeline
According to their positioning, teams using high-intent targeting see significantly better performance compared to traditional LinkedIn outreach.
The real shift here isn’t “better copywriting”.
It’s better targeting.
If you’re in sales, growth, or outbound - this is worth looking at.
